title: B2b tired legs, flat
coachNotes: Cut from 1h10m/400m D+ after Saturday came in at load 138 vs 70 planned (18.7km, 745m D+, avg HR 154). Legs are already more tired than the b2b intended, so the stimulus is banked. Strip the descent: ITB just absorbed 745m and stacking more on fatigued legs is the flare mechanism. Strictly Z1-Z2, walk any climb. Week 5 is a Build jump to 435 load, arrive fresh.
